answer: Sybil farms win on scale, so a reward curve below the cost curve beats any gate. A new identity opens at a maturity multiplier near zero: it stakes and answers yet earns almost nothing, since weight accrues only over consecutive epochs. At its zenith it merely matches an honest veteran, so patience buys parity, not privilege. Untransferable, it leaves a thousand fresh keys in one shallow lagoon of zero payout. Leaving it means funding and feeding each key for many epochs, so volume buys no discount, only a longer bill; one duplicate finding resets the cluster, its record brittle as crystal.
